before.name: Evertree District
before.basicInfo: The Evertree rises above pale civic buildings, gardens and the northern residential quarter. Broad approaches connect the court, the Cloud District and the great avenue below. Public streets and controlled palace rooms have different access.

before.name: Northwest District
before.basicInfo: Green western ridges descend toward the northwestern city wall. Greywatch Keep and the Emberfox pools overlook roads leading to Phoenix Wing and the upper residential streets. The maintained approaches are busy; wooded slopes beyond them grow quieter.

before.name: Harbor District
before.basicInfo: Northern shore roads meet the working waterfront and Hydra Head Academy. Cargo sheds, homes, gardens and coastal farms share the approaches to Whitecrest Harbor. Beaconrest Lighthouse marks the offshore channel.

before.name: Whitecrest Isles
before.basicInfo: Rocky islands and sheltered channels lie beyond the harbor. Saltmere and Driftstone support ordinary island households, while the isolated skull-shaped Wraith Island receives controlled prison traffic. Weather and working boats shape everyday journeys.

before.name: Southwest District
before.basicInfo: Western gates, Gryffin Tail and closely fitted residential streets occupy the southwestern city. Rougher Greyfield housing gathers outside the southern walls, beyond which the land rises into pines. Maintained streets remain ordinary civic ground.

before.name: Artisan Quarter
before.basicInfo: Founders’ arcades, workshops, inns and the Crucible fill the central southern wards. Timber carts and students share the streets with shoppers and craftspeople. The lower wall separates working neighborhoods from the patched roofs of Greyfield.

before.name: Southeast District
before.basicInfo: Dragon Hoard, the eastern residential wards and the south gate overlook shore roads and neighboring farms. Commercial lanes connect the central city with Pebblewick and the coast. Workshops and quiet homes continue between the larger landmarks.

before.name: Crescent Coast
before.basicInfo: Curved beaches and small rocky islands follow the coast south of Whitecrest. Inns, fishers and visiting boats use the sheltered inshore water. Exposed reefs require care even when the nearby beaches are peaceful.

before.name: Pinewater Vale
before.basicInfo: Pinewater winds between wooded banks, farm tracks and the lanes around Pebbletown. Caravan staging and a remote alchemical cottage stand near the crossings. Water level, loose banks and ordinary animal activity give practical work to people who know the valley.

before.name: Seaward Bluffs
before.basicInfo: Forested coastal bluffs give way to open meadows above a winding river. Starlark Abbey offers a settled presence inland, while the Seaward Overlook remains a quiet place to watch the sea. Exposed edges and weather demand sensible footing.

before.name: Bluecoil Reach
before.basicInfo: Open blue water surrounds distant reefs, the Gilded Albatross anchorage and an isolated serpent resting place. Sailors distinguish ordinary coastal passages from the waters around a sleeping great beast. Sudden swells and scarce landing places reward preparation.

before.name: Moonarch Shoals
before.basicInfo: Broken island stonework, a stranded wreck and broad shell-shaped rocks interrupt the eastern sea. Fishers know usable approaches and signs of larger creatures passing beneath them. The wreck waters are considerably less forgiving than the sheltered island coves.

before.name: Greenrush Marshes
before.basicInfo: The river breaks into shallow tidal channels, reed beds and sandbars before meeting the eastern sea. Boatwrights, fishers and field workers use its changing margins. Dry-looking ground can flood quickly with an incoming tide.

before.name: Longgrass Meadows
before.basicInfo: Wide grasslands stretch between the western forest and the lower river. A few farmsteads and cart tracks leave large areas of open ground. Herding, gathering and ordinary rural travel occupy more of the landscape than ruins or fortifications.

before.name: Sunmead Plain
before.basicInfo: Low hills, open pasture and scattered copses fill the southern plain. Thin dirt lanes link homesteads with the river crossings and neighboring meadows. Long sightlines let travelers notice weather, livestock and distant trouble before approaching.

before.name: Greenfield Farmlands
before.basicInfo: Cultivated strips and scattered homesteads spread beyond Greyfield and the city’s southern approaches. Irrigation branches lead toward the wider river country, while wooded margins conceal quieter ground. Farm roads carry produce, laborers and travelers.

before.name: Westpine Forest
before.basicInfo: Pines cover western ridges beside the lower river country. Clear working paths and old crossings skirt denser wildlife habitat. Woodcutters and walkers use the forest without treating every quiet clearing as a monster lair.

before.name: Southglade Woods
before.basicInfo: Southern woodland rises around an old stone lookout and scattered clearings. The outer tracks meet open grazing country; deeper folds of forest shelter wary animals. Old Southwatch can be reached without searching for a secret road.

before.name: Brookmeadow Downs
before.basicInfo: Open downs and the westward village approaches surround a working windmill. A crossroads links the northern road, river bridge and farm lanes. It is settled countryside with room for travelers to pass without becoming part of every local dispute.

before.name: Brookmeadow Vale
before.basicInfo: Brookmeadow’s houses, green and crop plots stand beside a river approach in the southeastern countryside. Farmers, mill customers and visiting workers share the lanes. The village remains a familiar local beginning within Glowhaven’s wider territory.

The Chainbreak Docks - Night Shelter.description: Night Shelter forms part of The Chainbreak Docks. Pale masonry and violet-painted wood enclose a compact, practical space. Its furnishings suit the establishment around it; the neighboring passage remains clear for people going about their work.

The Chainbreak Docks - Repair Steps.description: Repair Steps forms part of The Chainbreak Docks. A clear central working space sits between tool racks and secured materials. Repairs, unfinished pieces and well-used benches show the difference between a display and a functioning trade.

The Chainbreak Docks - Locked Store.description: Locked Store forms part of The Chainbreak Docks. Pale masonry and violet-painted wood enclose a compact, practical space. Its furnishings suit the establishment around it; the neighboring passage remains clear for people going about their work.

before.name: Starwatch Isle
before.basicInfo: A small outer island has a navigation shelter and a maintained waterside shrine. Boat crews leave practical offerings and watch the channels; the place is not automatically a cult sanctuary.

Starwatch Isle - Small Landing.description: Small Landing forms part of Starwatch Isle. Wet ropes loop around worn mooring posts beside a narrow working edge. Boat traffic and the height of the water determine where it is sensible to stand.

Starwatch Isle - Waterside Shrine.description: Waterside Shrine forms part of Starwatch Isle. Pale stone, a violet hanging and a small celestial lamp frame a place of ordinary devotion. Foot-worn approaches and everyday service objects keep it distinct from a royal chamber.

Starwatch Isle - Signal Shelter.description: Signal Shelter forms part of Starwatch Isle. Pale masonry and violet-painted wood enclose a compact, practical space. Its furnishings suit the establishment around it; the neighboring passage remains clear for people going about their work.

before.name: The Sunken Bell
before.basicInfo: A damaged old marker and submerged masonry interrupt an exposed coastal shelf. Locals know a cautious low-water approach; deeper investigation needs a real way to breathe, work and return.

The Sunken Bell - Outer Mooring.description: Outer Mooring forms part of The Sunken Bell. Pale masonry and violet-painted wood enclose a compact, practical space. Its furnishings suit the establishment around it; the neighboring passage remains clear for people going about their work.

before.name: Starward Commandery
before.basicInfo: A working paladin chapterhouse stands beside the sacred terrace, with a plain gate court, practice yard and field chapel. Ivory plate is repaired here between ceremonial duties. The order serves the crown and the celestial faith; its members do not always agree about what either service requires.
before.hiddenInfo: The Starward Oath has its own command and witnesses. It is distinct from the city watch, the palace household guard and the cult. A membership or a white cloak does not prove universal complicity.

Starward Commandery - Gate Court.description: Gate Court forms part of Starward Commandery. An open working space sits between pale walls and smaller doorways. Worn paving, a few benches and practical delivery access show where people gather and where traffic must keep moving.

Starward Commandery - Chapter Hall.description: Chapter Hall forms part of Starward Commandery. Pale masonry and violet-painted wood enclose a compact, practical space. Its furnishings suit the establishment around it; the neighboring passage remains clear for people going about their work.

Starward Commandery - Practice Court.description: A worn level court has blunted training weapons, moveable targets and a rack of shields. Observers stand behind a low rail. Water and bandages wait in a sheltered corner.

Starward Commandery - Field Chapel.description: A small high-star lamp hangs above plain benches. Medical rolls and repaired cloaks share a shelf with prayer books. The chapel is used by tired people rather than arranged as a museum.

Starward Commandery - Equipment Room.description: Equipment Room forms part of Starward Commandery. Practical furniture, folded cloth and a window toward the neighboring terrace give the room a lived-in scale. Personal storage stays separate from the shared walking space.

before.name: Imperial Court of Ardelis
before.basicInfo: King Cedran, Queen Isabeau and their households govern from Caelrath Palace. Three adult princesses have military, artistic and scholarly interests. Nobles, civic officials and the court mage compete for access and resources.
before.hiddenInfo: Cedran authorized the receiving program for war. Isabeau concealed coercion and pursues independent control. Severin controls the apparatus but is not her mindless servant.

before.name: Ivory Guard
before.basicInfo: The royal household guard protects palace rooms, escorts official movements and trains in the capital. Corvin Hale commands its daily service. Its remit differs from the city watch.
before.hiddenInfo: Conflicting transfer orders have reached the officers. Real evidence can divide loyalty; one friendly guard cannot command every patrol.

before.name: Order of the Starward Oath
before.basicInfo: Ardelis’s paladins combine trained arms with celestial devotion and crown service. Aurélian Vauss leads the capital commandery; Séraphine Duvray commands a field detachment, while Osmond Verain serves as chaplain and healer.
before.hiddenInfo: Its leaders differ over the receiving operation. Zeal, personal courage and genuine public service coexist with cruelty and compromised obedience. Do not equate the whole order with the cult.

before.name: Church of the High Star
before.basicInfo: Astraeon, the High Star, is the celestial deity honored in Ardelis’s temples. Laurent Bellegarde oversees the cathedral. Worship, relief work, ceremonies and institutional influence meet among ordinary believers with different convictions.
before.hiddenInfo: Sabine’s splinter circle is not the entire church. Laurent’s delay helped it grow; evidence can force accountability without pretending all worship is fraudulent.

before.name: House Montrevel
before.basicInfo: A landed house whose grain estates and credit sustain royal supply. Hector prizes authority and hospitality; Lucille runs much of its practical work.
before.hiddenInfo: Double-pledged grain and tenant hardship threaten its reputation.

before.name: House Dalcourt
before.basicInfo: A commercial house funding trade, workshops and imperial contracts. Julienne values clear terms and reliable delivery.
before.hiddenInfo: Marcel’s private guarantees expose family and workers to court debts.

before.name: House Veymont
before.basicInfo: A military family whose officers sponsor equipment, horses and frontier service. Armand expects discipline and loyalty.
before.hiddenInfo: Supply fraud and Adrien’s royal affair are separate liabilities.

before.name: The Glass Knives
before.basicInfo: A discreet Caelrath organization trading in stolen goods, protection, debt leverage and information. Lucan Voss prizes profit and a usable neighborhood.
before.hiddenInfo: Not all members share Lucan’s limits. They sometimes serve court intermediaries but have independent interests and no general cult allegiance.

before.name: The Unveiled Star
before.basicInfo: A private devotional circle known among a small number of seekers for intimate vigils and promises of extraordinary communion.
before.hiddenInfo: Sabine and her inner circle seek a physical vessel for Astraeon through coercive spirit-binding. Sincerity does not make their promises true or their victims willing.

before.name: Cedran Aurevain
before.visualDescription: A broad-shouldered older man with swept iron-gray hair, pale blue eyes and an old fencing scar at his jaw. A white-and-violet court coat carries a worn campaign clasp beside the crown seal.
before.basicInfo:
King Cedran Aurevain governs Ardelis with immense confidence in its historical destiny. He remembers campaigns, the names of old servants and precisely which promises he thinks the empire is owed. He can listen patiently to a difficult engineering explanation, then dismiss a political objection as timidity.

A broad-shouldered older man with swept iron-gray hair, pale blue eyes and an old fencing scar at his jaw. A white-and-violet court coat carries a worn campaign clasp beside the crown seal.

Equipment: A sheathed ceremonial saber, the royal seal, a folding campaign map and a smooth stone from his first command.

- Gender: male
- Species: Human
- Magic affinity: Enchantment
- Age: 62
before.hiddenInfo:
Private motive: Restore imperial influence before age and succession make his decisions someone else's inheritance.

Concealment and knowledge: He authorized the exceptional summoning program for the war, accepting evasive reports about its risks. He does not know the full extent of the queen's disposals or the cult's plans.

Pressure point: Credible losses among his own soldiers can reach him where abstract civilian suffering has not. Public humiliation makes him stubborn rather than automatically repentant.
personality: Patient about practical problems; impatient about limits on royal ambition.
Affectionate toward his daughters while assuming their futures are matters of state.
Keeps promises selectively and remembers being contradicted.
abilities: Old saber training supports a guarded retreat while the household guard works. He is not a hidden archmage.
Affinity practice: Enchantment. Affinity supports learning; use only finite actual techniques and the person’s level.

before.name: Isabeau Aurevain
before.visualDescription: A statuesque adult woman with long wine-black hair, dark green eyes and a deliberate, amused gaze. Structured violet silk, pale embroidered panels and carefully chosen gold jewelry create a striking court silhouette.
before.basicInfo:
Queen Isabeau Aurevain is a brilliant host and a dangerous opponent. She makes a visitor feel individually noticed, enjoys flirtation and fine performance, and rarely wastes an insult. Her public generosity is real expenditure whose beneficiaries can also become obligations.

A statuesque adult woman with long wine-black hair, dark green eyes and a deliberate, amused gaze. Structured violet silk, pale embroidered panels and carefully chosen gold jewelry create a striking court silhouette.

Equipment: A jeweled hairpin, a narrow correspondence case, a household seal and a small concealed defensive blade.

- Gender: female
- Species: Human
- Magic affinity: Light
- Age: 49
before.hiddenInfo:
Private motive: Keep decisive power through the next succession and make the new summoning apparatus answer to her household.

Concealment and knowledge: She orders intimidation and disappearances to protect the receiving project and treats the experimental losses as disposable costs. She also has several adult lovers, including Adrien Veymont and the singer Elise Vaubert; those affairs have their own jealousies and boundaries.

Pressure point: She can bargain over interests, but exposing one crime does not make her confess the others. A threat to her independent power can make her cruel and reckless.
personality: Warmly attentive while assessing what someone can provide.
Sensual, promiscuous and jealous of being managed by another person.
Capable of affection without extending mercy to people she finds inconvenient.
abilities: Practiced defensive enchantments and brief disorienting light support escape. Court influence is not supernatural consent or automatic mind control.
Affinity practice: Light. Affinity supports learning; use only finite actual techniques and the person’s level.

before.name: Lysandra Aurevain
before.visualDescription: A tall athletic young adult with tightly braided chestnut hair, gray eyes and a small healed cut across one knuckle. Her fitted riding coat mixes ivory with a deep military violet; her sword belt is plainly used.
before.basicInfo:
The eldest princess, Lysandra Aurevain, takes defense and royal service seriously. She learns the names of injured soldiers and is capable of an impressively tactless budget argument. Duty gives her purpose and an excuse to avoid admitting what she wants for herself.

A tall athletic young adult with tightly braided chestnut hair, gray eyes and a small healed cut across one knuckle. Her fitted riding coat mixes ivory with a deep military violet; her sword belt is plainly used.

Equipment: A cavalry saber, a plain buckler, field glasses and a notebook of supply figures.

- Gender: female
- Species: Human
- Magic affinity: Light
- Age: 27
before.hiddenInfo:
Private motive: Prove she can preserve a functioning empire without becoming her father's echo.

Concealment and knowledge: She has identified irregular research requisitions but initially fears that exposing them will collapse the war effort. She has not seen the receiving chamber or learned Noelle Ashford's origin.

Pressure point: Documented costs and the testimony of someone she respects carry more weight than flattering her as the reasonable daughter.
personality: Direct, capable and sometimes overbearing.
Protective of her sisters while resenting the work they leave her.
Finds improvisation irritating until her own plan fails.
abilities: A measured saber-and-buckler stance emphasizes guarded advances, short attacks and practical withdrawal rather than showy pursuit.
Affinity practice: Light. Affinity supports learning; use only finite actual techniques and the person’s level.

before.name: Marielle Aurevain
before.visualDescription: A lively young adult with wavy honey-blond hair, amber eyes and an expressive mouth that often looks close to a joke. Her blue-violet formal clothes favor asymmetrical ribbons and comfortable concealed shoes.
before.basicInfo:
Princess Marielle Aurevain is admired for her voice and avoided by people whose speeches she can imitate. She is generous company, a competitive gambler and far better at finding a weakness in an argument than finishing a tedious duty.

A lively young adult with wavy honey-blond hair, amber eyes and an expressive mouth that often looks close to a joke. Her blue-violet formal clothes favor asymmetrical ribbons and comfortable concealed shoes.

Equipment: A small lyre, a folding fan, annotated song sheets and a purse she should probably entrust to someone else.

- Gender: female
- Species: Human
- Magic affinity: Wind
- Age: 23
before.hiddenInfo:
Private motive: Choose a life and public role that are not merely a marriage arrangement.

Concealment and knowledge: She has debts to Lucan Voss's intermediaries after assuming royal status made her a better gambler. She has begun gathering real leverage, but her first attempts place other people's privacy at risk.

Pressure point: She responds to honest criticism from someone who will also laugh with her. Treating her as a harmless mascot quickly ends her cooperation.
personality: Funny, affectionate and incisive.
Uses entertainment to evade responsibility.
Can be brave in conversation and unreliable with an unpleasant follow-up.
abilities: A few practiced sound and diversion techniques create room to leave. She is not built to trade heavy blows with a veteran.
Affinity practice: Wind. Affinity supports learning; use only finite actual techniques and the person’s level.

before.name: Céleste Aurevain
before.currentArea: Caelrath Institute of Magic - Reading Room
before.visualDescription: A young adult woman with a neat dark-auburn bob, bright blue eyes and ink smudges that survive formal dressing. Her ivory jacket has violet piping over a practical ankle-length study outfit.
before.basicInfo:
The youngest princess, Céleste Aurevain, attends lessons and takes correction as a personal challenge. She loves difficult demonstrations, remembers small kindnesses and occasionally assumes that requesting something politely makes the imposition smaller.

A young adult woman with a neat dark-auburn bob, bright blue eyes and ink smudges that survive formal dressing. Her ivory jacket has violet piping over a practical ankle-length study outfit.

Equipment: A student grimoire, a practice wand, a magnifying lens and a box of pressed leaves.

- Gender: female
- Species: Human
- Magic affinity: Nature
- Age: 19
before.hiddenInfo:
Private motive: Become competent at work that matters without relying on the family name.

Concealment and knowledge: She has noticed that one injured research assistant was removed from the infirmary register. She hid a copied appointment slip out of fear and does not understand the larger project.

Pressure point: She needs evidence and a feasible next step. Flattery can tempt her into a bad decision, but cannot grant training she has not done.
personality: Curious, earnest and proud.
Bickers with her sisters and dislikes being protected without being consulted.
Can apologize sincerely after first making matters considerably worse.
abilities: Supervised novice casting and sensible cover are more reliable than her ambitious spell ideas.
Affinity practice: Nature. Affinity supports learning; use only finite actual techniques and the person’s level.

before.name: Severin Morcant
before.visualDescription: A lean man with long ash-brown hair tied behind his shoulders, pale gold eyes and fine burn scars on one wrist. His layered indigo coat carries silver measuring clasps rather than a forest of medals.
before.basicInfo:
Severin Morcant is the court's exceptionally accomplished wizard. He is exact in a demonstration, dryly funny in good company and intolerable when someone interrupts a calculation. His consultations can be useful without making him a generous teacher.

A lean man with long ash-brown hair tied behind his shoulders, pale gold eyes and fine burn scars on one wrist. His layered indigo coat carries silver measuring clasps rather than a forest of medals.

Equipment: A long crystal-tipped staff, a diagram cylinder, calibrated metal rings and protective gloves.

- Gender: male
- Species: Human
- Magic affinity: Arcane, Enchantment
- Age: 56
before.hiddenInfo:
Private motive: Complete an operation that will surpass the former court mage's work and make his reputation permanent.

Concealment and knowledge: He knows the second summoning produced Noelle Ashford and designed the command apparatus. He minimizes the project's human costs to himself and fears the queen is seeking an independent operator.

Pressure point: He can recognize a technical failure and negotiate to preserve his life or work. Intellectual pride is not proof that he will choose the ethical outcome.
personality: Brilliant, precise and competitive.
Treats people as colleagues only after they withstand his impatience.
Capable of fear and self-deception rather than an infallible mastermind.
abilities: A stable staff guard supports layered wards, directed pressure and prepared spatial work. Complex techniques cost real time and Mana; he cannot attend every fight in the city.
Affinity practice: Arcane, Enchantment. Affinity supports learning; use only finite actual techniques and the person’s level.

before.name: Hector Montrevel
before.visualDescription: A heavyset older man with close-cropped salt-and-pepper hair, dark brown eyes and carefully maintained hands. Green waistcoats, pale linen and a family ring suit a person who expects to be heard.
before.basicInfo:
Hector Montrevel manages a noble household built on grain and provincial credit. He can remember a grower's circumstances after one supper and still demand a payment that ruins them. His hospitality is comfortable rather than timid.

A heavyset older man with close-cropped salt-and-pepper hair, dark brown eyes and carefully maintained hands. Green waistcoats, pale linen and a family ring suit a person who expects to be heard.

Equipment: An estate seal, reading spectacles, grain samples and a ledger with a repaired cover.

- Gender: male
- Species: Human
- Magic affinity: Water
- Age: 60
before.hiddenInfo:
Private motive: Preserve his household through the next royal succession and a poor provincial harvest.

Concealment and knowledge: Some emergency grain has been pledged twice through arrangements he approved. He hopes to replace it before a public audit and initially lets a steward carry the blame.

Pressure point: A workable financial settlement can matter more to him than moral argument. His affection for family does not automatically extend to debtors.
personality: Sociable and patient with practical expertise.
Possessive of family standing.
Generous when generosity leaves him in control.
abilities: He withdraws behind household guards and knows only modest defensive practice.
Affinity practice: Water. Affinity supports learning; use only finite actual techniques and the person’s level.

before.name: Julienne Dalcourt
before.currentArea: House Dalcourt Counting House - Family Office
before.visualDescription: A composed adult woman with coiled black hair, copper-brown skin, gray eyes and a small beauty mark by her mouth. Deep blue working silk and a sharply cut pale jacket carry little loose ornament.
before.basicInfo:
Julienne Dalcourt leads a commercial noble household and dislikes pretending that money is a vulgar subject. She is reliable about explicit terms and ruthless about terms someone failed to ask for. Family suppers bring out a more chaotic side than her office suggests.

A composed adult woman with coiled black hair, copper-brown skin, gray eyes and a small beauty mark by her mouth. Deep blue working silk and a sharply cut pale jacket carry little loose ornament.

Equipment: A contract case, a seal with replaceable inserts, a compact abacus and a concealed utility knife.

- Gender: female
- Species: Human
- Magic affinity: Metal
- Age: 46
before.hiddenInfo:
Private motive: Secure a new harbor concession before a rival household controls the channel works.

Concealment and knowledge: Her son Marcel Dalcourt has used household guarantees for private deals with the queen's circle. She is investigating him quietly and has not decided how much loss she will accept to protect him.

Pressure point: Credible records and a practical alternative can change her position; calling every profitable contract criminal cannot.
personality: Lucid, competitive and fond of a well-made argument.
Sets high standards and can be cruel about a subordinate's mistakes.
Keeps private affection awkwardly separate from business.
abilities: Careful defensive casting protects withdrawal and documents; she does not mistake a hired escort for personal invulnerability.
Affinity practice: Metal. Affinity supports learning; use only finite actual techniques and the person’s level.

before.name: Armand Veymont
before.visualDescription: A square-built man with cropped dark hair, a silver temple streak, steel-blue eyes and an old broken nose. A severe violet officer's coat sits over practical riding clothes.
before.basicInfo:
Armand Veymont combines real military service with profitable supply contracts. He is brave under direct danger, exacting about discipline and much less interested in investigating the convenient assumptions behind his own accounts.

A square-built man with cropped dark hair, a silver temple streak, steel-blue eyes and an old broken nose. A severe violet officer's coat sits over practical riding clothes.

Equipment: A cavalry sword, a service gorget, dispatch seals and a plain map case.

- Gender: male
- Species: Human
- Magic affinity: Earth, Light, Fire
- Age: 53
before.hiddenInfo:
Private motive: Keep the empire committed to a war policy that secures his household's influence and validates his losses.

Concealment and knowledge: He has knowingly accepted inferior lots from a favored supplier and misdirected complaints. He suspects Adrien Veymont's intimacy with the queen but does not know its exact terms.

Pressure point: Demonstrated failure in the field can shake his certainty, while a purely personal accusation may make him close ranks.
personality: Courageous, proud and abrasive.
Loyal to people he considers his own.
Ready to treat opposition as cowardice when it suits him.
abilities: A firm sword guard, decisive short advances and controlled protective magic support an experienced officer rather than a legendary champion.
Affinity practice: Earth, Light, Fire. Affinity supports learning; use only finite actual techniques and the person’s level.

before.name: Laurent Bellegarde
before.visualDescription: An older man with soft white curls, warm brown eyes and a stoop that eases when he begins to sing. A simple star clasp closes his layered cream-and-violet vestments.
before.basicInfo:
First Prelate Laurent Bellegarde leads the capital's cathedral chapter. He values public worship, a functioning relief kitchen and peace between households. He can make a patient listener feel heard and a blunt critic feel quietly postponed.

An older man with soft white curls, warm brown eyes and a stoop that eases when he begins to sing. A simple star clasp closes his layered cream-and-violet vestments.

Equipment: A worn prayer book, a pastoral staff, a relief-house seal and spectacles in a mended case.

- Gender: male
- Species: Human
- Magic affinity: Healing, Soul
- Age: 67
before.hiddenInfo:
Private motive: Keep the cathedral useful to ordinary people without surrendering it to the crown or a dangerous sect.

Concealment and knowledge: He dismissed an early warning about Sabine Mauclerc as personal resentment. He now has troubling evidence, but fears a public accusation will punish innocent believers and expose his own hesitation.

Pressure point: Checked testimony and a plan that protects actual people make action possible. A demand to denounce the whole faith does not.
personality: Patient, humane and attached to institutional stability.
Dislikes admitting that moderation can become delay.
Enjoys a good argument once it stops being a public performance.
abilities: Modest healing and protective ritual support people already within reach. Faith does not make him a combat avatar of the deity.
Affinity practice: Healing, Soul. Affinity supports learning; use only finite actual techniques and the person’s level.

before.name: Sabine Mauclerc
before.visualDescription: An adult woman with dark-brown hair in a smooth braid, pale hazel eyes and a precise, intent smile. Her public teaching clothes are cream wool and faded blue, with an ordinary devotional pin.
before.basicInfo:
Sabine Mauclerc is a respected devotional teacher and former choir director. She speaks clearly, remembers people's troubles and has little patience for what she calls comfortable faith. Her generosity can make disagreement feel painfully personal.

An adult woman with dark-brown hair in a smooth braid, pale hazel eyes and a precise, intent smile. Her public teaching clothes are cream wool and faded blue, with an ordinary devotional pin.

Equipment: A tuning fork, a ritual notebook, a small string instrument and neatly wrapped teaching materials.

- Gender: female
- Species: Human
- Magic affinity: Summoning
- Age: 41
before.hiddenInfo:
Private motive: Bring the High Star into immediate physical communion with believers, with herself among the people who make it possible.

Concealment and knowledge: She leads the Unveiled Star splinter cult and has promised a dangerous embodiment rite. A court intermediary supplies restricted materials. She interprets warnings as proof of the cost of devotion rather than consent to stop.

Pressure point: Evidence of deliberate fraud among her own circle can split her confidence. Revealing the rite's danger may divide followers without converting her on the spot.
personality: Charismatic, disciplined and sincerely devout.
Turns personal loyalty into moral obligation.
Can accept sacrifice most easily when another person bears its cost.
abilities: Prepared soul wards, sustained sound and limited summons require actual setup. Her followers remain people with individual knowledge and fear.
Affinity practice: Summoning. Affinity supports learning; use only finite actual techniques and the person’s level.

before.name: Lucan Voss
before.visualDescription: A lean man with brushed-back black hair, light brown eyes and a handsome face interrupted by a small old lip scar. A midnight-green coat and immaculate gloves hide very practical tailoring.
before.basicInfo:
Lucan Voss owns part of a private supper club and arranges introductions for a price. He is excellent company when he chooses, attentive to a worker's real skill and entirely capable of making a polite threat sound like helpful advice.

A lean man with brushed-back black hair, light brown eyes and a handsome face interrupted by a small old lip scar. A midnight-green coat and immaculate gloves hide very practical tailoring.

Equipment: A narrow dueling blade, contract slips, a set of good lock tools and a silver cigarette case used for notes.

- Gender: male
- Species: Human
- Magic affinity: Illusion, Void
- Age: 43
before.hiddenInfo:
Private motive: Control the profitable edges of harbor trade without becoming disposable to the court.

Concealment and knowledge: He directs the Glass Knives' protection, stolen-cargo and debt operations. He will bargain with nobles or cult suppliers but has no religious devotion and resents anyone treating his people as expendable.

Pressure point: Actual loss of revenue, exposed arrangements or a credible better bargain can move him. His concern for selected neighbors does not make the organization benevolent.
personality: Funny, observant and selective with loyalty.
Patient about a profitable solution.
Cruel when he thinks fear is cheaper than negotiation.
abilities: A compact blade stance and dirty practical openings favor escape or a quick advantage. He does not duel honorably by default.
Affinity practice: Illusion, Void. Affinity supports learning; use only finite actual techniques and the person’s level.

before.name: Aveline Marchand
before.currentArea: Adventurer's Guild - Caelrath Branch - Reception Counter
before.visualDescription: An adult woman with a short glossy black bob, gray-green eyes, warm olive skin and a single copper hairclip. A neat teal vest over cream sleeves looks practical and carefully mended.
before.basicInfo:
Aveline Marchand runs the branch reception with brisk courtesy and an excellent memory for a request's missing detail. She enjoys useful field stories, dislikes boastful clients and occasionally laughs at exactly the wrong moment before recovering her professional expression.

An adult woman with a short glossy black bob, gray-green eyes, warm olive skin and a single copper hairclip. A neat teal vest over cream sleeves looks practical and carefully mended.

Equipment: A branch stamp, a pen case, a small filing key and a personal notebook of route corrections.

- Gender: female
- Species: Human
- Magic affinity: Healing
- Age: 28
before.hiddenInfo:
Private motive: Make the branch dependable enough that people stop confusing a dangerous commission with a glorious one.

Concealment and knowledge: She quietly pays for her younger adult brother's failed apprenticeship and is losing patience with his explanations. She sometimes gives returning veterans more benefit of the doubt than they deserve.

Pressure point: Honest results and a willingness to correct a mistake earn more from her than charm alone.
personality: Direct, attentive and quietly funny.
Capable of warmth without turning every visitor into a friend.
Stubborn about fair terms and less fair when family is involved.
abilities: Basic staff defense and practical first aid support an orderly retreat. She is a trained clerk, not a disguised elite fighter.
Affinity practice: Healing. Affinity supports learning; use only finite actual techniques and the person’s level.

before.name: Bastien Rochefort
before.currentArea: Adventurer's Guild - Caelrath Branch - Branch Office
before.visualDescription: A broad adult man with cropped sandy hair, blue-gray eyes and a weathered cheek scar. A dark-blue travel coat covers a practical vest; one sleeve has been repaired by an obviously better tailor.
before.basicInfo:
Bastien Rochefort heads the capital guild branch after years of escort and recovery work. He is calm about an honest failure and very hard to impress with a dramatic excuse. In private company his dry jokes become steadily worse.

A broad adult man with cropped sandy hair, blue-gray eyes and a weathered cheek scar. A dark-blue travel coat covers a practical vest; one sleeve has been repaired by an obviously better tailor.

Equipment: A short polehammer, a reliable field coat, route notebooks and a tin of overstrong tea.

- Gender: male
- Species: Human
- Magic affinity: Earth, Wind
- Age: 48
before.hiddenInfo:
Private motive: Keep the guild independent enough to refuse disguised military conscription and predatory clients.

Concealment and knowledge: He once accepted a contract whose undisclosed purpose harmed civilian carriers. He has records but fears an investigation will punish the surviving crew before reaching the client.

Pressure point: A credible plan to expose responsibility without rewriting the crew's actual choices can earn his cooperation.
personality: Measured, practical and capable of a firm refusal.
Protective without promising safety he cannot provide.
Can mistake endurance for a solution to a problem that needs help.
abilities: A two-handed polehammer guard controls short approaches and protects a withdrawing companion. He favors reliable positioning over elaborate finishing moves.
Affinity practice: Earth, Wind. Affinity supports learning; use only finite actual techniques and the person’s level.

before.name: Nerissa Vale
before.visualDescription: A tall adult fae woman with long dark-teal hair, gold eyes, pointed ears and broad feathered wings with white tips. A charcoal field coat and red scarf contrast with battered practical armor.
before.basicInfo:
Nerissa Vale is a veteran adventurer temporarily based in the capital. before.text:
The four great Archmages whose followers established Phoenix Wing Academy, Hydra Head Academy, Gryffin Tail Academy and Dragon Hoard Academy founded Glowhaven. Their work belongs to the city's own beginnings. Four Sages Bazaar's monument remains a public reminder.

Glowhaven no longer answers to Ardelis or its royalty. Its former political connection has been cut, and it conducts the affairs of an independent polity. The Great Sage governs through Glowhaven's own institutions. Ardelis's crown has no standing authority over the city or its academies.

The legend that the founders planted the Evertree together remains part of civic memory. Its exact circumstances and the tree's deeper nature remain uncertain.

The academies preserve different interpretations of the founders’ legacies. The shared monument is a civic meeting point rather than proof of every retelling of the planting.

Ardelis is a large predominantly human empire with agricultural provinces, older administrative cities and competing military frontiers. Caelrath is its capital, not the whole country. Its rulers retain the familiar titles King and Queen while governing an imperial realm. Cedran Aurevain wants to restore imperial influence during his remaining years; different provinces bear different costs. The capital’s elegant stonework and elaborate water infrastructure depend on ordinary farmers, masons, boat crews and clerks. This map contains Caelrath and its immediate working approaches. Distant imperial cities remain part of the wider world rather than additional destinations on this capital map.

Astraeon, called the High Star, is the ancient celestial deity prominently honored in Ardelis. His existence does not establish the correctness of every priest, royal order or interpretation. Public worship includes ordinary services, memorials, music, relief work and family observances. Laurent Bellegarde leads the capital cathedral. Paladins serve the crown and faith through a distinct order, with differing loyalties. A secret splinter circle, the Unveiled Star, seeks physical communion through a coercive vessel rite; its ambitions are not the doctrine or knowledge of every believer. The deity is not automatically compelled to appear because someone finishes a diagram.

House Aurevain’s adult daughters have separate lives: Lysandra is an officer concerned with military competence; Marielle wants artistic independence and has made dangerous financial promises; Céleste is a novice researcher who wants her work taken seriously. The crown has not announced a new succession settlement. Montrevel controls grain and landed credit, Dalcourt commercial finance, Veymont military patronage and Orselle cultural access. These are influences, not compulsory careers for every relative. Marriages, contracts, rivalries and personal loyalties can matter without making every conversation a succession crisis.

The Order of the Starward Oath combines formal arms, celestial devotion and crown service. Its capital commandery has three particularly visible figures: Aurélian Vauss, a proud protective commander; Séraphine Duvray, a courageous zealot willing to excuse coercion; and Osmond Verain, a field chaplain troubled by what he has treated. A paladin may protect a crowd, investigate a threat or obey a bad order. The order is distinct from Corvin Hale’s palace household guard, the ordinary watch and Sabine’s secret cult. Named leaders retain their levels and identities; routine detachments use the Starward Paladin type and finite numbers.

The Caelrath Branch belongs to the same Adventurer’s Guild as Glowhaven and Benitsuru. Genuine existing badges and partial assessment results are recognized. Aveline Marchand handles reception and Bastien Rochefort runs the branch. Judgment uses a labeled hypothetical sample; the practical is a bounded onsite demonstration. Neither is a live work contract. Certification alone grants the canonical Bronze Document badge, with no duplicate Relic, key or fee. Offer one relevant real contract after licensing or a deliberate later request. Beginner work includes rats, orchard pests, deliveries and repairs; Silver and Gold work can be declined. Prices and wages use marks only, and configured native payouts are not paid again in dialogue.

The Evertree and Caelrath Portal Hall are the fixed endpoints of a restricted bilateral route. A reusable Ardelis Portal Key works like the existing destination keys after an authorized actual handover. Genuine named sponsorship and a credible purpose matter; academy membership or a claim to nobility is insufficient. Vladimir can arrange an independent meeting at the Evertree without joining a party. Glowhaven’s court and Henri Valcour provide an earned alternative route. Physical return from Caelrath’s sole fixed return arch always reaches the Evertree Portal Room and does not need a key. An Ardelis start grants no automatic international permit. Local offenses do not use Glowhaven’s Wraith Island automatic custody system.

Cedran and Isabeau are married, and Lysandra, Marielle and Céleste are their adult daughters. Isabeau has separate adult affairs with Adrien Veymont and Elise Vaubert; secrecy and jealousy do not imply anyone’s blanket consent. Adrien is Armand’s adult son. Julienne and Marcel are mother and adult son. Hector is Lucille’s uncle. Mireille and Isaline are adult cousins. Félicien and Léonie are adult cousins. Aveline and Luc are siblings; she is tired of rescuing him from poor plans. Lydie and Hervé Valette are married, affectionate and able to quarrel about real household decisions. Léonie and Denis are fellow adult students with a competitive friendship. Coralie trusts Matthieu’s careful work when he actually checks it. Do not invent romantic ties for everyone else or infer that a single character is available.

before.text: Caelrath is a wealthy imperial capital. Opaline Arcade has jewelers, perfume salons and couture boutiques, while the Violet Market and ordinary neighborhood trades serve different budgets. Noble households patronize bards, instrumentalists, actors and dancers at the Velvet Lyre Hall, amphitheatre, theatre and private salons; performers also have wages, rivals and artistic choices. Colors, fabrics and patterns vary rather than making every resident a violet-uniformed courtier. Most local human names follow the capital’s established European-style naming; foreign residents keep their own names. Beneath the polished streets, Agathe’s maintenance crew tends the sewers from Eastwater access stairs. Storm drains and foul-water channels are separate from sealed drinking-water conduits. Raised inspection walks, sluices, closed branches and a tide outlet make a connected bounded work site, not a magical shortcut to every private cellar. Some abandoned branches shelter small wildlife, slimes or occasional smugglers; maintained streets do not become dangerous merely because drains run below them.
